title: Bible Compass Concepts
classificationNote: Categories organise browsing. Types, domains and life areas are independent, many-to-many facets. Classifications and relationships are editorial study mappings, not claims that Scripture defines this taxonomy. Counts describe this curated catalogue, not the whole Bible.

categories.title: Doctrines
categories.summary: Beliefs about God, salvation and our future.

categories.title: Biblical Frameworks
categories.summary: Patterns and metaphors that help us understand and respond.

categories.title: Spiritual Practices
categories.summary: Ways of responding to God in daily life.

categories.title: Principles
categories.summary: Truths that guide our choices and character.

categories.title: Biblical Themes
categories.summary: Threads that connect passages across Scripture.

concepts.title: Judgment
concepts.summary: God judges evil and holds people accountable with justice. Final judgment is one expression of this wider biblical concept.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul describes God judging impartially.
Jesus describes the Son of Man judging the nations.

concepts.title: Salvation
concepts.summary: God rescues people from sin and brings them into life with him through Jesus.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Salvation is God's gift through faith, with good works as its fruit.

concepts.title: Resurrection
concepts.summary: Jesus rose from the dead; Christian hope includes the resurrection of the dead.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul connects the resurrection of Jesus with the future resurrection of those who belong to him.

concepts.title: Trinity
concepts.summary: Historic Christian teaching that the one God is Father, Son and Holy Spirit. The term summarises a reading of Scripture rather than naming a word used in it.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus commands baptism in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Paul brings together the grace of Jesus, the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.

concepts.title: Justification
concepts.summary: Being put right with God through Jesus. Christian traditions differ in how they explain aspects of justification.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul links justification through faith with peace with God through Jesus.

concepts.title: Grace
concepts.summary: God's freely given favour and help, received rather than earned.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: God's gift precedes the good works believers are created to do.

concepts.title: Full Armour of God
concepts.summary: Paul's armour metaphor describes standing firm in God's strength through truth, righteousness, the gospel of peace, faith, salvation and God's word, with prayer.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: The struggle is not against flesh and blood. Stand in God's strength and pray; this is not permission to treat people as enemies.

concepts.title: Fruit of the Spirit
concepts.summary: A picture of the character the Holy Spirit grows in believers, including love, peace, patience and self-control.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: The fruit belongs to a life led by the Spirit, rather than a scorecard for earning acceptance.

concepts.title: Beatitudes
concepts.summary: Jesus' blessings describe the people and character of his kingdom, including the merciful, peacemakers and those who hunger for righteousness.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus opens the Sermon on the Mount by describing those who are blessed.

concepts.title: Parable of the Sower
concepts.summary: Jesus uses seed and soils to describe different responses to the word of the kingdom.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Read the parable alongside Jesus' explanation of the soils.

concepts.title: Prayer
concepts.summary: Turning to God in praise, confession, gratitude and requests, trusting his wisdom.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus teaches sincere prayer and gives a pattern centred on the Father, his kingdom and daily dependence.

concepts.title: Fasting
concepts.summary: Voluntarily abstaining from food for a time as a spiritual response to God, rather than a display of religious status.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus teaches fasting without seeking public admiration.

concepts.title: Repentance
concepts.summary: Turning from sin towards God, involving a change of mind and direction.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus calls people to repent and believe the good news.

concepts.title: Worship
concepts.summary: Honouring God with our hearts, words and lives.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus speaks of worshipping the Father in Spirit and truth.
Paul connects worship with offering our lives to God and a renewed mind.

concepts.title: Stewardship
concepts.summary: Caring faithfully for resources and responsibilities entrusted to us.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Use received gifts to serve others as stewards of God's grace.

concepts.title: Forgiveness
concepts.summary: God forgives sin, and calls people to forgive others. Forgiveness does not remove the need for truth, boundaries or accountability.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul connects forgiving one another with God's forgiveness in Christ.

concepts.title: Justice
concepts.summary: Acting rightly and fairly, reflecting God's concern for truth and the vulnerable.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: The prophet joins justice, mercy and humble walking with God.

concepts.title: Humility
concepts.summary: Receiving our place before God honestly and considering the needs of others.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul points to Jesus as the pattern for humble service.

concepts.title: Covenant
concepts.summary: A committed relationship established by God, with promises and responsibilities that shape the biblical story.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: God establishes his covenant with Abraham.
Jesus speaks of the new covenant in his blood.

concepts.title: Kingdom of God
concepts.summary: God's reign, announced and embodied by Jesus, with a future fulfilment Christians await.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Jesus announces the arrival of God's kingdom.
Jesus teaches his followers to pray for God's kingdom to come.

concepts.title: Redemption
concepts.summary: God sets people free through Jesus, bringing forgiveness and restoration.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul connects redemption in Christ with forgiveness and God's purpose.

concepts.title: Spiritual Warfare
concepts.summary: Resisting spiritual evil through dependence on God, faithfulness and prayer. People are not the enemy.
concepts.graceGuardrail: God's grace in Jesus is a gift. Learning or practising this concept does not earn God's love.

scripture.insight: Paul directs believers to stand firm in the Lord rather than fight against people.

relations.note: Paul uses the armour metaphor to describe standing firm in spiritual conflict.
Salvation is pictured as a helmet within Paul's armour metaphor.
Paul follows the armour imagery with a call to pray in the Spirit.
Paul describes salvation as a gift of grace through faith.
Good works follow grace; caring for entrusted gifts is one editorial application.
Paul connects the saving Christian hope with Christ's resurrection.
Paul describes God's judgment as impartial.
Jesus places the Beatitudes in the context of the kingdom of heaven.
Jesus explains the seed in relation to the word of the kingdom.
The Lord's Prayer includes asking for God's kingdom to come.
Forgiving others responds to the forgiveness received in Christ.
Micah joins doing justice with walking humbly with God.
Paul connects redemption with the forgiveness of sins.
Jesus joins the announcement of the kingdom with a call to repentance and faith.
Offering a life to God is an editorial connection to humble dependence.
